deploy-bot: Manual approval required to proceed with PROD deploy
deploy-bot: Environment: prod/us-east-1
deploy-bot: Tag: release/v2.4.1
deploy-bot: Commit: 3b7f9a2 (chore: bump tokenizer fallback)
deploy-bot: Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC
deploy-bot: Release notes: https://redwood-inference.internal/releases/v2.4.1
deploy-bot: Reason: DB index background migration + runtime tokenizer fallback; requires prod gate approval from @elaine and one on-call

alice: quick question — does the migration require any leader migration step or downtime?
carla: It’s a background index add (CONCURRENT in PG). No exclusive locks expected. I tested on staging with 10M rows, ~6m total, no downtime.
carla: Migration file: sql/migrations/20260320_add_user_profile_idx.sql

dinesh: can we confirm canary metrics before approving? last release we saw a small memory regression.

deploy-bot: Canary run summary (canary-prod-1):
- Duration: 30m
- Traffic slice: 5%
- Latency p50: +0.2%
- Errors: 0.05% (threshold 0.5%)
- Memory/oops: no OOMs observed
- Logs: https://logs.internal/canary/3b7f9a2

deploy-bot: DB migration flagged: background index, estimated runtime 5-10m on replicas. Rollback plan: rollback script at /runbooks/prod/rollback-v2.4.1.sh

elaine: thanks for the canary summary. @oncall-sre — can you confirm infra health (no capacity surprises) and sign off?
oncall-sre: checked nodes in prod/us-east-1. CPU/mem within baseline. There was a brief CPU spike on node-17 earlier today but unrelated (batch job). I’m happy to sign off for this window.
oncall-sre: APPROVE :white_check_mark:

elaine: I also want the release pinned in the version map before rollout. Please pin to release/v2.4.1-prod-20260320.
elaine: APPROVED to proceed with rollout. :rocket:

dinesh: approved from SRE side as well — will monitor during ramp.

deploy-bot: Approval received from: elaine, oncall-sre, dinesh
deploy-bot: Initiating phased rollout: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%; 5m observation between steps (auto-abort on error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > baseline + 25%)
deploy-bot: Expected finish ~ 2026-03-20 22:18 UTC

alice: noted. I’ll keep an eye on error budgets for the first 30m.
carla: reminder: if we need to pin back, use tag rollback/release-3b7f9a2 and run /runbooks/prod/rollback-v2.4.1.sh

deploy-bot: Rollout started — will post progress updates in this thread!
